The 14th Amendment is the cornerstone of our democracy. The Amendment establishes that everyone is entitled to equal protection under the law, and that the state cannot deprive any person in its jurisdiction of life, liberty, or property without a fair trial. Unfortunately, **I know too well that the government doesn’t always respect our constitutional rights.** I was born in a Japanese Internment camp in Poston, Arizona. Over 120,000 other Japanese-Americans were imprisoned based solely on race and nationality. You also know this, as just this year we saw Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) murder Americans in the street, rip children away from their families, and wrongly deport people like Kilmar Armando Ábrego García with no trials to be imprisoned in nations they have no connection to. The 14th Amendment also established birthright citizenship, the idea that anyone born in the United States, regardless of their parents’ legal status, is a citizen. For years, the Trump administration has attacked birthright citizenship, and it wasn’t until two weeks ago that the Supreme Court decided, 6-3, that the 14th Amendment clearly enumerates this right. **[I will never stop fighting to ensure the Trump administration respects the constitutional rights it must uphold, but I need your help to keep doing so. Friends,
I was on _CNN_ with Kasie Hunt this afternoon, and if you missed it, I wanted to tell you myself what we talked about - because it matters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Here 's the heart of it: This primary is now a two-person race.**
The choice in front of Michigan Democrats is Abdul El-Sayed or me. Two options. That's it, the whole kit and caboodle. And with the primary less than a month away and absentee ballots already in voters' hands, this race is no longer some far-off thing on the calendar. It's happening right now.
So the question Kasie asked - and the question every Michigan voter deserves a straight answer to - is simple: How do we win this election?
_The Cook Political Report_ has already weighed in. They said, "If El-Sayed wins the primary, Democrats have little chance of holding the seat."
And look, that's not some Stevens campaign talking point. That's the opinion of nonpartisan folks whose whole job is being real about Senate races.
Senate Republicans have clearly done the same math. Why else would their campaign arm be spending money in a Democratic primary to prop up Abdul El-Sayed? The truth is they'd rather face him in November than face me.
I said it on _CNN_ , and I will say it again here: **Michigan will decide control of the U.S. Senate, and it 's very hard to see a path to flipping the Senate without winning here.** So what happens in the next few weeks will help determine whether Donald Trump has a rubber stamp from Mike Rogers or a real check on his agenda.
None of this is abstract, friends. This is real-life stuff with real consequences for Michiganders.
I'm talking about Social Security, reproductive freedom, gas prices, and manufacturing. I'm talking about health care - and whether working families have someone in the Senate fighting for them.
Poll after poll shows I'm the Democrat best positioned to beat Mike Rogers. Not because I'm the flashiest person in the room. Not because I've gone viral. But Because I've spent my career with my sleeves rolled up, doing the work.
I helped save 200,000 Michigan auto jobs during President Obama's auto rescue. I helped bring semiconductor manufacturing back home. I've won tough races in Michigan before, and I know what it takes to build the kind of coalition that wins in Michigan in November.
**Michiganders know the difference between a candidate who talks about the fight and one who 's been in the arena.** I've been doing the work for this state I love - and now it's time to earn every last vote.
So that's the next 26 days: a two-person race. Ballots out. Senate control on the line. National Republicans already meddling in our primary. And a campaign that's going to outwork everybody, every single day, until August 4.
If you saw the interview and you're in a position to chip in, I'd be truly grateful. This is a people-centered grassroots campaign, and your $20, or whatever you can manage, helps us reach voters in these final weeks while it matters most.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you.
With grit and determination,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e131cfb4-f7ae-47d1-92b0-c0fbc11b5ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
I take this job pretty seriously, Peter.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260709-1&t=1&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)
Peter,
I take this job pretty seriously.
I spend a lot of time thinking about how to help every single one of the candidates we endorse win their elections. And you want to know one thing that helps me sleep at night?
It’s knowing that, since our launch in 2023, **almost 16,000 of our grassroots supporters** have signed up to make monthly recurring donations to Leaders We Deserve.
**[These donations are crucial to sustaining a movement like ours, so today I wanted to reach out and ask if you would set up a monthly recurring donation too.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=2&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
_Use the links in this email to start a recurring donation to Leaders We Deserve._
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-3701&t=3&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
Here’s why these recurring donations are so helpful:
* They allow us to set a baseline for what we bring in each month, so we can budget that money toward our most pressing priorities.
* They help us get to work well before Election Day. A month before the election is too late to hire and train organizers, buy TV ads, and compete with more established, well-financed campaigns.
* They help create a snowball effect for our candidates. A lot of donors and organizations look at how much early money candidates raise to inform whether they should get involved, and recurring donations let us back young, progressive candidates early on to show their credibility.

**[So if you’re ready to elect more of the leaders we deserve, please sign up to make a monthly recurring donation of any amount that works for you today. It will help more than you know!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/5229?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.qYJIwU&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=4&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**
Thanks again for all your support,
David Hogg
P.S. Can’t commit to a monthly donation today? Not a problem. **[If you can make a one-time contribution of $5 or any amount at all, you’ll make a big difference in helping us reach our goals and elect the next generation of leaders.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260709_1_recurring.ZGVbos&refcode=em20260709-3701&amount=5&t=5&akid=3701%2E587540%2Ez9hENk)**

body:
We must stop the suppressive SAVE Act and all of its clones in the Senate, because the opponents of voting rights in the House keep trying to check these voter suppression bills off their to-do list.
Why? Listen to Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut:
(Image of Richard Blumenthal speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_RB.jpg]
RUSH $35 or more right now to stop these bills, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Donald Trump is demanding -- again -- that Congress pass the SAVE America Act (the latest version of the anti-voting SAVE Act). With the House set to pass it again this week, the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections, folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet on the impact of these bills:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, join these brave Senators today. Fuel our efforts to stop this dangerous legislation with $35 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]

GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=070926_2&amount=50]

We know the SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before November, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE America Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=070926_2&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=070926_2&amount=20]

Hi there, it’s Nancy Lacore, the Democrat running to flip South Carolina’s First District.
I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.
And now, he’s waging a war with Iran that could put our national security and countless American lives on the line.
That kind of behavior isn’t just destabilizing – it’s dangerous.
Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.
If we’re going to flip this seat and take back a Democratic House Majority, I need your help. Can you make a split donation of $25 or whatever you can, to Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
DONATE NOW TO HELP NANCY FLIP THIS SEAT! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
I’ll be honest, folks, I’m concerned.
While global tensions rise, the last thing we need is reckless leadership that’s willing to gamble with American lives.
We need steady, experienced leaders who are focused on delivering results – not inciting chaos, playing political games, and putting their own interests above the nation’s.
And I’m running for Congress to restore that kind of leadership – but we have a long road ahead of us to flip this seat and restore some accountability to Washington.
This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and it could decide control of the House. So I need all hands on deck to win. So I have to humbly ask: Will you split $25 today to support Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]

Iran War Reignites
President Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire "over" Wednesday and [ordered fresh strikes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1yhSAUhJ9GOxw8KngLijR2N21K5wTw3pPw4wBKkqfPmEdItbvF7s58b_f1juQoPF7RW6VPWk006-6wBJviUYz1UScs2Vh0lVbgIBiXjN_W4Na-NUobMUBrVS_nQYwgblP7VEK_CxgnDRvIDbicJ2EMiF72YponxJbUtcRlzznv537o-LjhZgYr5STNJHUz8mM3WGzudAzZphMLnZZCiJeLodPRt049S9lzM7w0sDSw1Fq7LX4FW6-ab2BxdFp25QaWkg6_syMzShhYxcRySfRp86VIhT1j8scP-zjcN7u1SZm9knOUhWxG_vBI7u-1_APUqeA3AAD__wRMef0) on roughly 90 Iranian military targets after Tehran resumed attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. The Islamabad memorandum collapsed as Iran targeted tankers in the vital waterway. [Oil markets jumped](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LHO3CAQBOCnwR0WYAx3BUUad3_alNb-7PpuFQwWcHYeP3IeId0Un0aj-fW1fgEnzq-fsFOIJ69YcD0S9Ey1fDrSXmKF3pAgXbwaZZxUXqrnmtOqBwwR3WQGCto_JmeNe87DO9gnPaJDQ_Om3TfSFr0CPVv9rSerjB443E3Ka6WUfuhpVHaDDSfyfvY4-yis-hwIndoYS25UT-h8Eudc7lTyGMs-pPDu_Whi-iHMIsxyXdd4QXtzfvWS6Q_snKneVJgl09VuU2pCYRbrrFJ-FmYpnORROVKT7eDfJHv97IdEigkqoYwEjTauJLlCluWkKswy1IDHxSlxc15Y9dqB079V_T-OPIP5GwAA___o3oR5), with Brent climbing above $78 and pump prices ticking up nationwide. Trump said Iran called seeking a new deal but questioned whether Tehran could be trusted. The administration also [revoked sanctions waivers](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLuypSAURL8GMyzEBxoQTEJ2J53Q2he2nj3DwwKU35865xNu1kl3r1p_vvYvIE_x_A0BtX1od8ntl4caMae7OgzJZqjFIfhGuxRy4UJxse3R70PntHXLKDvUg1rHZZLLNncvvQmLbhICcB6-1aoGPI5RidU5uW64fnek30tCDUKIYR3GXkwHHG5EpWblZmXZJO7LQcXS2xQL5gcqPUgxpndKsbcpdF6_ar0KG38xaZg0rbW-QXlRPGuKlcKnHpg0EVth0rxfmTR_b8-kWZk0d-GUIXKLUPCgjNwm7-EqWDgEcjxi46Vm-oeF13yHi4fb-8Izlgq5UjyZNF3W7mrkPZVFsUmcAch_COsPpD5a_g8AAP__iHOJbQ) that had let Iran sell crude during the truce. Republicans framed the response as restoring deterrence, with Trump warning any further attack would be met "twenty-fold." ★★★
Judge Spared In ICE Case
Former Milwaukee County Judge Hannah Dugan was [fined $5,000](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0DvOpDAQBODTQGZkzMMzgYNNyGbTDVFjN9AjP5DdwB5_xR7hzyqpT6X685k_QJ7i9hsCGnvR7JKbDw8cMaeTHYZkM3BxCP6mWUk1CqmFfM_Rz23tjHVjp2o0rX51Y6_G91Dv5mWXzsmllasc7Khbi0raDvoVYLE4YE3mkaRupZTtq-0a2a-wug61HrQbtK16eR4OGEtjUyyYL2C6kGJMT0qxsSnU3uzMR6m6X5WaKjXd992s6W_E-6mFSk1H8sRkS6WmNeWAWdxUHpGi-J5uQ7FDjLALd24QBVyJXBFfIC-YAoq0FM6nZYqbgJyxsCDvcQMvKATaMkSus3HHTd5TGXXVyy0A-f_7-AeXXkb9CwAA__-zr4wO) and spared prison on Wednesday for obstructing a federal immigration arrest inside her courthouse, despite facing up to 5 years in prison. U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman, a Clinton appointee, [cited her service](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGyozAQRE8jMrnEYCQcEGxC9jfdkBprBhiXkFySgOtv2Uf4WSf9uuv9-5l_UILE9S_uPPpTZko0vwPWyDkdlXhPPmMtxBgumcGA1cZp85hjmNuGRk-2g4bH1g2dvYN99M02ekBnoKfetsMTwD2Y3NM8npbZ4rDYRsYPybjWGNMObXcz9wUX6ti53lHvvLqb401Yudx8ioXziVVOlhjTJ6V482lvwrjV-i6q-6NgUjBd13W7sGwS15pilf1b3xVMka-iYPqsKpheR1AwDQqmDWPETdOxYtRLyjtn_TpoZX1tSadnqfnwlUmLZ405c6l6kcik8UxCRb9QPqwmj_S-JAQp1qm7WXeU8P1Yf6H1HOF_AAAA__8sFIlq) and called her a good person who made a bad decision. Dugan had ushered an illegal immigrant out a side door as ICE agents waited in April 2025. Prosecutors argued she violated her oath and endangered officers and the public. Conservatives blasted the [lenient sentence](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL3SpCAURJ8GMyy8_qABwSZk36YbWixcnTuFYAHKPP6W8wibddJ9us6fn_XHkKew_zYHKnvT6qJbT29KwBSv4vCINpmSHRpfaQUBExeSi2UNfu0ap6ybemhQdXLupwGmZWxeCsQ2oh0tdK7HTWyzW8QwIYrZ9uMilobUsyRkJ4To5q5vxbCZzfUo5SjdKC0bxHU6UzC3NoaM6TaFbqQQ4pNiaG08Gq9epZyZ9b8YaAa61tpWk18U9hJDoeNbPxjogDUz0A-VgX5fnoGeGWj88Er5QVDg78vtyPNpEjp-Jsox8Pg3l3TZQmHnZJGblDAXfuCHrAkMdJOUOyt5T3mSbBD7Ych_35X_EHor-BcAAP__MdSHuA) as a two-tier standard, noting guidelines called for 15 to 21 months behind bars. Dugan plans to appeal. ★★★
Vance Task Force Targets Fraud
Vice President JD Vance's anti-fraud task force uncovered a staggering 7,100% surge in Medicare claims for skin substitutes, [officials revealed](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL0OnDAQhJ8GOiNjDIbCRRq6S5sSbXbN3er8g2wDefyIPEK6mWJGn75fr-0F7Dm-f0JwFi_eKNF2eKjR5XRWciFhhlrIgb95U1JNQhohly36rW_JIk2Dap3tzTxMWk3L2H6sHpbJDAshLXoZZ5Kjnns5okKcjZ6xZfs8SdNLKfu5Hzqpd9hpcMaMhkaDjZbnQVBd6TDF4vIFlS_HMaYnpdhhCq23n1qP0gw_GrU2ar3vu9vTn-juZxYatR7Jc2UsjVprPsMhgAJHcUZMl8tFPASinPntRHDECNmJmiGWw0OsAj1wKAJiZbFnOElgBvxSuqP47RN-HYnA3nOKpc2WjvspZTKNlu8A7P9h1v8we1n1NwAA__9cjIxl) -- from $200 million in 2019 to $14.4 billion in 2025. CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz said the agency has flagged 4,200 suspicious claims and denied 96% of them since March. Speaking in Milwaukee, [Vance touted](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0DGSrCAUheHVYNbW5YKgAcFLzPqlE1oIl26qECylZZY_5SxhspOcL_i_nsvTxhTz67_dyLgrLr74ZU-2ZjrKp3raijtsPT3Z1OKCgOoB-gHTktPCO2-cVwI7MlyPQklU09C9DScHKFxY5aiRa6kGjhymKawSh3UNXTS3BJoDAB-56EEGG7wgrQftB-2YhM_ubaWzdyWfdFy2xotizuVeJfeubF0y71r3k4l_DGeGc2utD-U7U7tvG8P5ip4Kw1lJgEGJCUfOsTuM31tMKZ5KMwmvzcb0C9Y_NLgM_gQAAP__PzZpgg) a broad crackdown spanning Medicaid, visas, and elections. In the primary, our opponent had over $8.5 million in combined spending between his multiple adversary Super PACs and spending over $5.3 million of his own money. So we know that this will still be an expensive and competitive general election, as our opponent will continue to self-fund and has the support of wealthy out-of-district Silicon Valley donors and multiple Super PACs. subject: Wisconsin's own regulators just admitted it

body:
The report Big Tech doesn't want you to read
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260709-3013)
Peter,
Last week, Wisconsin utility regulators released a [report](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15905?t=1&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) that outlines the impact of AI data centers.
Our state's peak electricity demand is projected to surge [40%](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15906?t=2&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) in just six years. And nearly three-quarters of that entire spike (72%) comes from just three hyperscale data centers: Beaver Dam, Port Washington, and Mount Pleasant.
_The hero Wisconsin deserves!_
The issue is not your air conditioner, nor is it Wisconsin farms or small businesses. We’re getting hosed by three data centers owned by some of the richest corporations in human history.
How do the utilities plan to meet this demand? The single biggest chunk of new power (5.4 gigawatts of it) will come from fossil gas plants. That means [coal retirements will be delayed](https://act.francescahong.com/go/15907?t=3&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) and dirty energy will be locked in for decades. All so Big Tech can train chatbots.
There is still no statewide plan for any of this. No guardrails. No guarantee you won't end up paying for it on your utility bill.
This is exactly why Fran has been calling for a [moratorium on new hyperscale data centers.](http://act.francescahong.com/go/15908?t=4&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) Her plan is a common-sense pause until Wisconsin has real rules that protect our grid, our water, our climate, and our wallets. When Fran first said it, the political class called it radical. Now the state's own energy assessment is proving her right.
The other candidates in this race won't say the word "moratorium." Fran will. She works for you, not the corporations rewriting Wisconsin's energy future behind closed doors.
[**The primary is August 11. That’s just under 5 weeks away. Chip in $10 to elect the only candidate who saw this coming and has a plan to stop it.**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=5&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&amount=5&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=8&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)**
In solidarity,
— Team Hong
P.S. [70% of Wisconsin voters (](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=9&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)[_across party lines_](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=10&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)[)](https://act.francescahong.com/go/16017?t=11&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7) already believe data centers cost us more than they give back. Fran is the only candidate standing with that 70%. [Stand with her today](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260709.z7esw6&refcode=em20260709-3013&t=12&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7).
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260709-3013&t=13&refcode2=3013_105371_b9Ufs7&akid=3013%2E105371%2Eb9Ufs7)**

“Not qualified.” That’s
what the American Bar Association rated one of Trump’s judicial nominees
because they lack the basic qualifications for the bench.

Let us explain: Trump has nominated 60 crony judges to the federal
judiciary in his second term — 45 of whom have been confirmed.

They’ve been asked the simplest questions about reality. Who won the 2020
election? Was January 6th an attack on the Capitol?

And they all refuse to give a straight answer, because apparently the sole
qualification needed for a lifetime seat on the bench is loyalty to Trump
only.

This is Trump’s playbook: hand-pick judges who'll never rule against him,
push them through confirmation, and fill the bench with political puppets
who will protect him at all costs.

We’re calling it what it is — stacking the courts. And Demand Justice PAC
isn’t going to sit back and watch it happen.

We're digging into these nominees' records, putting their loyalty tests on
the record, and turning up the pressure so senators feel it every time

Hard work and playing by the rules used to be enough. That was the deal. You show up, put in the hours, do everything right, and you build something stable. A home. A future. A life your kids can step into with confidence.
**That deal is broken, and politicians like my opponent Scott DesJarlais helped break it.**
While families across Tennessee's 4th District are working two jobs just to cover groceries, while parents lie awake wondering if their kids will ever be able to afford a home of their own, DesJarlais has spent 14 years in Washington protecting the donors and insiders who bankroll his career. **How do I know?**_**I 'm living it **_**with my boys:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8f3537f6-5d2d-4d43-a475-a841ac548e25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**I 'm running for Congress because I look at my boys and I refuse to accept that the America they inherit is one where effort doesn't matter anymore. [Will you stand with us?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Chip in $25, Help us hit our goal!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We aren't seeing representation anymore. Corporate and Foreign interests have infiltrated our government. The "American Dream" isn't their priority anymore because **corporate checks line their pockets.**
To Scott DesJarlais and every other bought-and-paid-for politician in Washington: consider this your notice. I got to this state with nothing to my name, and was able to build a family while pulling through the worst. My goal is to make sure **you** can do the same, and not have to break your back in the process.
The people of this district are done waiting, and we're coming. ☑️ _**[Chip in $20 today and let's finish this.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b6ade95c-cc78-45ce-92dc-32ee7adbae9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)☑️**_

subject: How we partnered with the Trump administration to rebuild Wisconsin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Will Martin for Lt
body:
When we talk about creating opportunity, we must ensure that no community in Wisconsin is left behind, whether it's a rural town in the Northwoods or an urban neighborhood in Milwaukee.
Peter,When we talk about creating opportunity, we must ensure that no community in Wisconsin is left behind, whether it's a rural town in the Northwoods or an urban neighborhood in Milwaukee.**That's why I was incredibly proud to lead the effort to select and finalize Wisconsin's 120 federally designated Economic Opportunity Zones under the Trump administration.****[[BUILD OPPORTUNITY IN WISCONSIN ➔]](https://willmartinforltgovernor.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ydujudhk-hkjudtlhit-r/)**These zones were designed to incentivize private investment in economically distressed areas. Instead of relying on big-government handouts, we used conservative tax incentives to encourage job creators to invest right here in our communities.This initiative helped:
* Attract millions of dollars in private capital to Wisconsin.
* Create jobs in communities that had been forgotten for decades.
* Build a solid foundation for long-term economic prosperity.

**This is the power of conservative economic policy. When we cut taxes and encourage investment, Wisconsin wins.** As your Lieutenant Governor, I will continue to champion these free-market principles to revitalize our state.Our grassroots campaign is powered by supporters who believe in the power of opportunity. Can you chip in $10, $20, or $50 today to help us share this vision with voters across the state?**[[BUILD OPPORTUNITY IN WISCONSIN ➔]](https://willmartinforltgovernor.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ydujudhk-hkjudtlhit-y/)**Thank you for your support!Best regards,Will Martin

## Israel Warns US of Iranian Threat to Trump
Israel warned the United States of a new [Iranian plan to assassinate President Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnTAQRb_GdH4abIOhcPFWEUqzaVKkRLN4WDsxGNnDov37iM0npL7S0T3n1-v8ijHF_f0HbuR4zfNOV03ETGXmcm6HJ-TAoRAy13PHLdZzVqB6CVa2MHuM6XM2jXcrkSLdkGvtoHtrh7FrglNACJ1ese3fjLbGgx0Gg6gXQuzGsYnupoFtoQUwnX68kQdtxrUHDcavIAyQj5zL43eOOwda02f-oPJY8tYkF5iPKvRTqEmo6bqux1b3exNqol2eVajplrrHXJIXaooFdxmQl0BeroVqkEfKLDnLPzEl-SUuYy1ISXJO_h8Fi3w-lX1pv2uhp7xEL_S3lzseXfUnlaMpzh9XTCnW3goD7xvG9HWT_6vth1N_AwAA__9DPI7E), according to a Thursday report by the _Wall Street Journal_. Qassem Soleimani. Trump alluded to the assassination threat on Wednesday, telling reporters, _" I guess I've been a little bit lucky, but that maybe doesn't last very long."_ Meanwhile, the U.S. and Iran traded [new attacks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ8GOqOxzU8oXGxDl223RAMeB-81dmQPQblPf0Ve4XajOdKn851_9_mOPvj4-Is7GXZpjnSWQMyUZ87H_rSEvPGWCZnLEXH35ZgVqF7AICTMFn14z21tjSNSpGsycrjpfhhuY1dvhhxKvcgenEUNo5bDMkLXUU9I60pUe3PRYJAgAdpONwtZ0O3oetDQWgdVC2Q9p9z8Tz7yRi6804tys6a9DmZjfpZK_6nUVKnpPM8mLutlceXXJ-VgKzX5jLFS01HEdYlIp0BmXL-K-IiKlbCQ85nERRePIzixpbwf3yKvEXWne9nV2djn6UPwpR-qFh47-vBpwr-a72XUTwAAAP__UvSG4w) for a second day, with American forces hitting around 90 military targets after Tehran attacked commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Phoenix hit 113 degrees for three days straight, and its firefighters have answered 400 heat calls since May 1. The area's 18 heat-related deaths are more than triple last year's pace. Giant Paper Plane Sets World Record Engineering students at Italy's University of Pisa set a for the largest paper airplane, a 23-foot craft with a 65.75-foot wingspan built from only paper and glue. The plane, dubbed Icarus, glided nearly 200 feet across a Bologna exhibition hall after a single push from a 10-foot platform. . Fifteen students spent months building it, using roughly of paper and 132 pounds of glue layered into honeycomb structures for strength without weight. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | • | Anchor Point Research ---|--- • | Salem Media Group • | Brownstone Research | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. ## Faculty Groups Sue Texas Tech
Two faculty groups sued Texas Tech Chancellor Brandon Creighton and the university system's regents on Wednesday over [rules restricting classroom instruction](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3unDAQxJ8GOiN_HSaFizR0_7Qp0R6sj5WMjewF7t4-4l4h3RQzP83M35_pByhSev2BDT2_Q54SXjUiM5bJPrYZ6gr7XpE54oaJZyiMk5a6F9IJJacFKH4m2y7-KZdfqkWv3GD6QRndt6t3Vppl0CG4wQGCcT047SwY8zAhGNWSv2HSKamU1NJ0IK0a9NAHa_rnQ2FjJS7EuXS8IuMbaoiffGLp5ry10a_Me23M70aPjR6v6-pCftt7xm1o9HjLRo_fqGCcV3EkOrFU4o8IMFN6iQhXPYjFzRVHmnOqTHww5QRRzPkoFUXBk_AS5YhY2-KX_aIYqfausfK1AcVvI_6_H0-v_wUAAP__N6uKfA) on race, sex, and gender identity. The federal suit, [filed in El Paso](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE9jMiPbeAw_cLAJ2d90Q9RjN4MlA5a7gc_tVzPaG2xUpQpelerP9_QNKaft9RtW9Pwz79OGF2VkxjrZxxqAFiiFkDnjihsHqIyTUcZJ1Uutpggp35Nton-q-KUb9LofOjfozrhm8drMrjODMk4psF8Rn_bx0DN2GAY1RNck_4apXiutlVFdC8rqwQxutp17PjQKqzAm3mvLCzL-AM353k-sbdjXJvuFuZDofgkzCjNe19VuAKHkOLd7fQkzlopEsmJGIBRmBDiK_IDkx8LMkg78FzGGRR5bOrFS4lvSTYyrfBfKisQ1BU4nyrAfld6yMW4sy55TSEjCjE31sVwp50SuF1a9Vkj5M5b_7-LTm78BAAD__wmXk9g) by the American Association of University Professors and its Texas affiliate, challenges two memos requiring professors to submit course material on those topics for regents' review. It asks a judge to block enforcement across the five-campus system. The groups argue the rules violate the First and Fourteenth Amendments and discriminate against black faculty. "_This is based on discrimination against populations that have ideas that the Chancellor finds to be disfavorable, and that is unconstitutional_ ," said Antonio Ingram, an attorney on the case. The Texas Tech System [said it is confident](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OhCAUBeCnwQ4DyIAWFNvYzbZbGn6uShbRwJ1x5u03zitsc29xki8n5-c-3W1MMS_fdgODr3mfMpw1ASKUSd42b-tqj6MCYoINMnpbECbBhKJMU86mYGN6T7IJxrEw8AYM132net4J1axGDko513caZm01V4rzwXkp7W0e5Mx0E82FMc0Z50ywrrVM8l70apadcjcORDIIEffS4goIL1vn9N6fUFq_b00yK-JRSfdFxEjEeJ5n--tduEIixssmYmT6Oj0R4wegCH6lbrcl0AILZKy0PiDQi6UFKpboMT6B-v1R6vUyQka6PGKAFDNUIsammHCcMaVYlSaSLZuN6VMK_zfl04i_AAAA__9gL4em) its policies are _"lawful, constitutionally sound, and fully compliant with state and federal law."_ Creighton, a former state senator, has defended the reviews as keeping coursework relevant for the workforce.
## Talarico, Paxton Announce Q2 Fundraising Totals
State Rep. James Talarico raised more than [$30 million for his U.S. Senate bid](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuS2zAQRE9DZqMCQJCCAwROlK1Th6wRMBBh4UMDs0vp9i76Cht31et-_ftj_cCYYnn8wkyWX6GuhY6eiJnaqufssG-4752YE2Uq7LAxrUqoBcQVpFg9xvRe9ejtXfgfciQrr2ZajJzUMm7WaCHcfdGzcT4E42YTwuK1mhVOJsxmjPaEiasUUgolpgsKLY0yS9DTcp8lDVqQj1zbhTdiemEP6V2_qF1czWOyG_Peh-nnoG6Duh3HcXkSP89wULfTZlC3P5ipA2PCFl2FhrFThxMCk4AcU4q1QCzQydXi4e_nqdnAYd4xPgp0fHfItRHwhgW4xT0RPKnAji-upUP_PPvGZv1-nLy-XActHhlj-j-Uv3fvl1X_AgAA__-UeZGG) from April through June, more than triple the $9 million reported by Attorney General Ken Paxton. Talarico's campaign called it the largest second-quarter haul ever by a Senate candidate in an election year, pushing his total past $70 million from 780,000 contributors since September. The campaign said 97% of donations were $100 or less. Paxton's camp touted its total as [the largest announced](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMlC7sYEJHFxCNpdeiHqgPfjWxshuDTN_v2J_YbMnlVSqev_u85188PvzL0W28nZp3vksgUU4z9rEhcpGx1FYJHDkXRbKwjMC9g0MjYJ5JR8-s65X-4D1pmq2ahi7flQd9vVmDTIaVqtzRM445dzNEQyEbqDVaKi9vcpgUKAUIHQtgVYjjr3TXf8wiisNvHpJuZWNhd9UXPikF-d2SbEOdhM5StX9qXCqcDrPs_3QltKVVjhddyqcjhS8-OVCyuKXwBf-p8ilEQqU_ZKaTL5wab54bw56S9obAK1xMKZvN4mhznY9Th-CL_1QaXhG8uFnhfzO3cvidwAAAP__pYGD0A) by any non-incumbent Republican Senate candidate this cycle, calling it a "clear signal that conservatives are rallying" behind him. Official reports identifying donors and cash on hand are due to the Federal Election Commission by July 15. [Recent public polling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DlvhDAUBOBfY3esfOGjcJGGbtOmRA94rC3ZgPDTHv8-2q3Sp57RJ838XMcr5JK32zdUjPRc93HDRytIhOdo-jpDS3AcDYkKVtxohpNwVELZTrhOinGBXF6j4UucxBIkxyid19ZLrSxPcQ291w40uhCC0kYqs2qrdZiWyQfjeY5vTDgppBRK6AsII73ydjXaTr1EZgQumfbzQgkJn9DW8trveF7mvfISE9HRmP5iamBqoIQpl_LOmBrSXvE9iKlhhnpAvm1MDX2wIrjQfbCu4QaEHUGBM89796fIz7gcj1xKbtYxI24V8ofm9L-z7lH9BgAA____FnyK) shows the race essentially tied.
## Texas Secures $45M Cash App Settlement
Cash App parent Block, Inc. [will pay $45 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ8GOqPxD4YULrahy7ZbImMPwZKNLTwJyduvSHMf4PbzzTnf-Xef7zbEsD_-2oSG3muedzxrRCI8ZtUnZ-tmS6lIFDHhTs4ehLMAoRkMjMPsbYifWbXeLOBvvEXDh1HqkUuh280oP4C4gQfvFMdFy5tbYNWLHJfeO4dtMNczGDhwDgJkZ0HxUYx6VVIvPcdGAfpA-ehoQ8K3rWv85BcencupjWYjKrWRfxoxNWI6z7Nb83uwz0phv04aMV1OjZi-MHOZRbS-MtWzFGIMeWc_fuwyZrYUdkUwjw4LhReyiu55BPowF21ItT2ML-eFVz00Ch7JhvhtRL_b8WXE_wAAAP__Z4WJ7Q) to settle a 46-state investigation co-led by Texas into claims it misled users about fraud protections. Texas will receive [nearly $5 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO3DAMQE8jdxpIlEafwkUad5s2pUFL9FhY-QObGc_ePvAkQA6w5SOBB_L9-ug_sNSyPH7iTC2_xrVf6DwqMdPe2_uc8Jhw2w5irjTTwgl3ph4UOKm81KrPWOpXb5vcDipH3VCrfTAuaAOumdqc4kDe2eitQoDoI7pAASFon81gmtJeMuW10lqBMjdUVgcIbrTGDXdNwirKhdf9xhMxvfAY69f6pP2W1rmp7cS8HcL8ENAJ6M7zvH0-f9O1FNDhziVVEtBdfwnoDka-8C2S_4Z_AR9yHceSSH7SIjd88brIK4DEbZP_EwjowEVpTfCeRi-VvYO0TieJ4JPMYXAmRjv6ITZ7m7ez1FoO54VVjxlLfd_N36v9bOFPAAAA__8HfpDM). Investigators said the company marketed the payment app as a safe, bank-like alternative while fraud outpaced its safeguards, leaving victims with no way to recover stolen funds. Within 30 days, Block must provide 24-hour customer support, simplify fraud reporting, and post scam warnings inside the app. A linked federal consent order requires consumer refunds of between $75 million and $120 million. | **President Donald J. Trump** and the **Republican National Committee** have announced the details for the **2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention** in **Dallas, TX, September 9 and 10.**

This is the first Mid-term National Convention in Republican Party history. President Trump believes it is important for winning Congressional elections and other elections this November. And he’s said on the record that **this Convention will be a** **“once-in-a-lifetime experience.”**

This Mid-term Convention will be different than standard presidential-election year conventions. The Republican National Committee has delegated selection of attendees to the various State Parties. But **the timeline to make these selections is tight** : State Parties have until **July 15** to submit their attendee lists to the RNC.

For best-possible speed and fairness, the WAGOP is distributing most of its convention tickets through **a** **modified Dutch auction** (also known as a **“sealed-bid, descending price”** auction). Bids start at $125 but can go as high as each bidder chooses. Republicans interested in attending the 2026 Mid-term Convention, can make a non-refundable bid at this link: [Support - Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP).](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=31141&L=15988&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS93YWdvcC8yYmE4ZjI2Ni1iNzk1LTQ4ZTgtYjQ4MS05ZGZkNzI4MWRhYTg/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=e8323a4cb98bc6eb74fdb94cf08ad9c307cab37533493c82eb78d73e7f5b408f)

WAGOP will distribute tickets based on **bids received by 6 p.m. on Tuesday evening, July 14**.
Bidders can place multiple bids, if they wish—but **all bids are non-refundable**.

NOTE: These tickets admit individuals to the 2026 Republican Mid-term National Convention. **They do NOT include travel or accommodations** in Dallas—and the RNC is requiring attendees to stay at designated Mid-term Convention hotels in Dallas. More details on those accommodations will be available after the attendee lists from each state are finalized.

WAGOP is continuing to get questions about how people can attend the 2026 Mid-Term National Convention. This modified Dutch auction is the answer. If you’re interested and inclined, [click here](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=31141&L=15988&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS93YWdvcC8yYmE4ZjI2Ni1iNzk1LTQ4ZTgtYjQ4MS05ZGZkNzI4MWRhYTg/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=e8323a4cb98bc6eb74fdb94cf08ad9c307cab37533493c82eb78d73e7f5b408f) and bid. This is the most direct way to **join President Trump, Vice President J.D. Vance and the rest of the Republican Party** in Dallas this September!

Thanks.

Jim Walsh, Chairman
Washington State Republican Party

Friends,

As I sit down with my morning coffee before heading out across the district today, I wanted to reach out and drop a quick note.
Campaigning across 15 counties—from Tallahassee out through the Panhandle—is a massive undertaking. But every single day, I am reminded why I got into this race: **because North Florida families deserve an ethics-minded, independent voice in Congress who actually answers to everyday people, and not the corporate special interest groups**.
---
| [DONATE TODAY!](https://us.list-manage.com/4Yammolmmei?e=58216231a8&c2id=8df47a7be007db4a464e6070248494ca)

subject: Illegal aliens living in $500-a-night dollar hotels?
body:
Friends,Career politicians "magically" can afford to put illegal aliens in fancy New York City hotels that cost over $500 per night, but ignore our veterans who need help._**How does that make any sense?!**_ Washington has forgotten what public service is supposed to be. Too many politicians are focused on climbing the ladder, attending cocktail parties, and serving themselves instead of the people who sent them there.With over 30 years in health care, I've seen just about everything. But the sickness plaguing Washington can only be cured with servant leadership - not career politicians or unelected bureaucrats.I served as a medical crew director on combat and combat support missions while supporting Operation Freedom's Sentinel. I witnessed firsthand the cost of defending freedom and the sacrifices made by the men and women who wear our nation's uniform.I've treated both the physical and invisible wounds of war. Now, I'm taking that same servant's heart to Congress to work alongside President Trump.
